response: Ward B (Dongri, Masjid Bunder) has billed INR 3507952 of its INR 4300000 road repair budget (81.6 percent) across 44 jobs. Of these, 20.5 percent were reopened within 30 days, and 56.8 percent met the promised repair time. The ward has a low lying index of 0.55 and the city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season, which may explain some repeat damage. Two points need review. INR 173383 was billed on DLP roads. These roads are still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs on them should cost the city nothing. Also, 5 jobs were priced more than 30 percent above the rate card. Work orders WO25-00611 and WO25-00700 should be checked as examples. Konkan Roadcon Pvt Ltd (synthetic) is the top contractor by spend. Ask the ward office whether the warranty contractor was asked to redo or pay for the DLP road repairs.
